metrics.help: Number of network interfaces present on the system.
sysUpTime value (in timeticks) when the interface entered its current operational state.
Estimate of the interface's current bandwidth in bits per second (32-bit ifTable object; ifHighSpeed is not implemented on this device).
Total octets received on the interface (32-bit counter; ifHCInOctets is not implemented on this device).
Total octets transmitted out of the interface (32-bit counter; ifHCOutOctets is not implemented on this device).
Inbound packets that contained errors preventing delivery to a higher layer.
Outbound packets that could not be transmitted because of errors.

notes: Device implements only ifNumber and a subset of ifTable; ifXTable (1.3.6.1.2.1.31.1.1) returned nothing, so all ifHC* counters and ifHighSpeed were replaced by 32-bit equivalents where present (ifInOctets, ifOutOctets, ifSpeed). ifSpeed is reported in bits per second, so the metric is named _bits rather than _megabits. Dropped with no working equivalent in the walk: unicast/multicast/broadcast packet counters (ifInUcastPkts, ifOutUcastPkts, ifHC*), ifInDiscards, ifOutDiscards, ifInUnknownProtos, ifOutQLen. Counters are 32-bit and may wrap on fast links; at 100 Mbps this is acceptable with rate() at typical scrape intervals. Lookup remains ifIndex -> ifDescr, which returned values.
